desktop.notes: Major Inbuilt Player upgrade: Zero-disk in-memory live stream engine with mpegts.js, instant start (<200ms), lossless 4K/1080p GPU decode, stereo AAC audio transcoding for UK MP2 & US AC-3 channels, and native MPV hardware player engine support.

android.notes: YouTube/Netflix streaming architecture: fine-grained 32KB allocation pacing, automatic HLS (.m3u8) switching on constrained/10 Mbps links, and low-bandwidth quality matching.
